DitherDivider.orientation: horizontal or vertical. A vertical rule fills the height of its container.
DitherDivider.label: Text in the middle of the rule, which splits around it. Horizontal only.
DitherDivider.fade: Share of each half that fades out, from 0 to 1.
DitherDivider.strength: Densest dither level, at the middle of the rule.
DitherDivider.fill: gradient fades through dither levels, the others fade by opacity.
